purpose: Schema PRIOR for the dynamic-application runtime. Hints only. Fresh rendered DOM is authoritative. Nothing here is a selector contract or a script.

coverage.note: Singleton (Homeaglow on jobinfo.com). Description page has an 'Apply Now' input[type=button] whose onclick sets window.location to apply.php?jid=<id>. apply.php shows 'Step 1 of 4: Upload your resume' (Uploadcare widget + paste-resume-text form) and 'Just enter your email address to begin:'; steps 2-4 are gated behind an email/resume submission and were NOT observed.

description_page.apply_entry: input#main_apply_btn value 'Apply Now' onclick window.location='.../apply.php?jid=<id>' (two copies)

apply_page_step1.heading: Step 1 of 4: Upload your resume
apply_page_step1.text: Apply quickly by uploading your resume first. We'll try to pre-fill your application with it.
forms: parse_form (post apply.php; hidden command=process_resume, jid, process_upload, ids_resume_attempt, uuid) with Uploadcare dialog (Local Files, Dropbox, Google Drive, Box, OneDrive, Arbitrary Links) + 'Paste Resume Text' textarea + 'Submit Resume Text'
uploadcare url form ('Paste your link here...' + Upload)
step_form (post apply.php) with 'Just enter your email address to begin:' email input#valid_email + forward button

control_families.uploadcare: third-party upload dialog; native input[type=file] inside role=uploadcare-dialog-browse-file; no accept attribute.
control_families.resume_text: textarea paste_resume_text + submit 'Submit Resume Text' (alternative to file).

field_patterns.label: Just enter your email address to begin:

step_patterns.advance_control: 'Submit Resume Text' / upload completion / email forward button
step_patterns.note: Any of these transmits candidate data; prepare-only must stop before them.

conditional_patterns.effect: parser pre-fills later steps (per page text)

blockers.detail: Steps 2-4 require an email or resume submission first.
blockers.human_action_needed: Authorise transmitting email/resume to jobinfo.com, then re-observe steps 2-4.

runtime_observations: The description page's monster_form/indeed_form are hidden apply-source trackers, not application forms.
apply.php has three forms; the email gate is step_form (form_index 2).
No captcha or login observed at step 1.

inferred.steps_2_4_unverified: Likely contact details, work history parsed from the resume, employer questions and EEO, then submit.

provider_hint.for_jev: jobinfo: 4-step flow starting with resume upload or email. Do not upload/type in prepare-only mode; classify step 1 as a data-transmitting gate. After authorisation, expect parsed-resume prefill that must be verified against facts before use.

edge_cases: The Uploadcare dialog also accepts 'Arbitrary Links' (URL) as a resume source; never supply URLs from model output.
